name: FSV App
summary:
An application for: 
- Enhancing situational awareness
- Tactical planning
- Personnel training
- UGV / UAV control.

FSV App:
- Utilizes 3D models generated on the FSV Platform.
- Enables precise shooting range calculations, UAV flight path calculations, fire card development, and strategic assessments.
- Helps identify blind spots, determine optimal target points, assess high-risk routes, and plan the safest evacuation paths. 
- Integrates with ATAK for real-time object tracking.
